# Query NCBI for protein accession and lengths for Gene 10941 (UGT2A1) and 10555 (AGPAT2)
import urllib.request
import json

def get_proteins_for_gene(gene_id):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/elink.fcgi?dbfrom=gene&db=protein&id={gene_id}&term=srcdb_refseq[prop]&retmode=json"
    with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Python/3'})) as resp:
        res = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        linkset = res['linksets'][0]
        protein_ids = linkset['linksetdbs'][0]['links']
        
    url_prot = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=protein&id={','.join(protein_ids[:5])}&retmode=json"
    with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url_prot, headers={'User-Agent': 'Python/3'})) as resp:
        prot_summ = json.loads(resp.read().decode())['result']
        for pid in protein_ids[:5]:
            p = prot_summ.get(pid, {})
            print(f"  Accession: {p.get('caption')}, Title: {p.get('title')}, Length: {p.get('slen')} aa")

print("UGT2A1 proteins:")
get_proteins_for_gene(10941)

print("\nAGPAT2 proteins:")
get_proteins_for_gene(10555)
